scenario: [LDIA.3.3.2] / [LCAP.1]: a retired capability name names no capability. `storage_hydrate_events` and `storage_event_query` are both `reserved` in `proto/capabilities.proto#Capability` and absent from the registry. A `use` block line spelling either, even set `false`, is DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY, exactly as a name that never existed is. A compiler that admits either name compiles this program. PATH PINNED: the registry lookup in override resolution in `dsc.dialect` (`capability_named`), which reads `ds.capability`'s members and nothing else.
rules_ds:
use default:
    storage_hydrate_events: false
    storage_event_query: false

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

rule r:
    Sensor
->
    log info "x"
